title: `website_name` bypasses the `untrusted_attributes` gate that hides `website` from anonymous TL0 profiles
description: `untrusted_attributes` lists `:website` but not `:website_name`, so for a TL0 user viewed by an anonymous visitor, `website_name` is still serialized. The field is exposed in the JSON API and renders on the profile when it shouldn't.

title: `include_website_name` is missing the trailing `?`, so it never runs
description: The method name should be `include_website_name?` to match ActiveModel::Serializers convention. As written, the method is dead code and `website_name` is emitted unconditionally.

title: Website in the profile header no longer updates after saving preferences
description: The removed `websiteName` computed property was reactive, but `User#save` doesn't copy `website_name` back from the response. A user who sets a website and saves sees it update but the website_name stays undefined until a full page reload.
